collection.title: Peugeot 5008 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot 5008 2017 - 2024 requires a 28 wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side, however some brands recommend 28" & 16". All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 5008 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
